description: Creates a part, an assembly or a drawing from the user's default template for it (or a named template) and makes it the active document. With path, saves it there at once. The document is the agent's own, so document.close may close it. A drawing comes with the template's sheet and sheet format and no view; sheet sets that first sheet's size, scale and projection (sheet mm). On a drawing it makes, the agent hides origins, planes, axes, sketches and points in its views and turns off inserting annotations when a view is made. Checked: the document is active and of the type asked; a drawing has one sheet reading back as asked, no view, and no command left open.

type.description: What to create: part, assembly or drawing. Default part.

template.description: Full path of a template: .PRTDOT for a part, .ASMDOT for an assembly, .DRWDOT for a drawing; the user's default template for the type when absent.

path.description: Full path of a file that does not exist yet, in an existing folder, with the type's extension (.SLDPRT, .SLDASM, .SLDDRW): the new document is saved there at once.

size.description: A standard paper size: a4, a3, a2, a1, a0 (ISO) or a, b, c, d, e (ANSI). Not with width_mm and height_mm.

orientation.description: With size: landscape (the default) or portrait.

width_mm.description: A custom sheet's width, sheet mm, with height_mm; 10 to 10000.

height_mm.description: A custom sheet's height, sheet mm, with width_mm; 10 to 10000.

numerator.description: The first number of the ratio, more than 0.

denominator.description: The second number of the ratio, more than 0.

scale.description: The sheet's scale, which every view that follows the sheet's scale is drawn at.

format.description: Full path of a sheet format (.SLDDRT) to draw the sheet in. The sheet's own (for a new sheet, the first sheet's) when absent.

sheet.description: Only for a drawing: the first sheet's size (a standard size or width_mm and height_mm), scale, projection and sheet format; the template's when absent.
